guidance.statement: Chemical division profitability is targeted to increase from ₹18-20 crore to ₹60-70 crore over the next 4 to 5 years.

entities.name: GBL Infra Engg Services Pvt Ltd.

industry: Energy > Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels > Oil > Oil Storage & Transportation

operating_notes.text: Chemical plant capacity is approximately 1,000 tons a month per plant across two plants, with utilization at 70% to 80%.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹72.57 Cr (+26.1% YoY), net profit ₹12.24 Cr (against a loss of ₹15.86 Cr a year earlier).
Ganesh Benzoplast reported zero deviation in the utilization of its ₹32.40 crore preferential issue funds for Q4FY26.
Ganesh Benzoplast held an investor call on October 7, 2026, detailing the ₹1,154 crore divestment of its LST business and outlining a pivot toward chemicals and EPC.

watchlist.text: Statutory and regulatory requirements for Singapore subsidiary
Port authority approvals for transfer of leasehold rights at JNPA, Goa, and Cochin

watchlist.response: Management explained that the valuation offered (₹1,154 Cr) is highly attractive, and chemical segment profitability has scaled significantly with higher future growth potential.
watchlist.text: Analysts questioned the rationale behind selling the high-margin LST cash cow business in favour of lower-margin chemical and EPC segments.
